scores.tell: Cup and saucer are a bit plump and rounded; the handle is thick. Flat rims are fine.
Truss tubes are thick and round. Corners are tight and the yoke is thin, so the part count is right.
none. Posts and doors have flat faces, straight runs and tight bevels, like the real swing.
Fuselage and engines are soft and swollen. Wings are thin and slightly wobbly, so it reads as a toy.
Box has straight edges. Roof corners are a little soft and the door frames slightly thick.
Table top and stools are flat and straight. The pedestal is a bit chunky and the stools are plain cylinders.
Saddle is a little puffy. The stirrups are thicker than in the grade-5 saddle.
Truss is fattened, with oversized rounded end caps. The yoke and body are blobby, so it looks like a toy.
Duck body is a fat toy blob. The spring is thin but the base plate is a soft pillow.
Panel is chunky with a rounded bulging body. Buttons and knobs are fat. The overall form is plausible.
